guide.intro:
Run Claude once on your own Mac, and you can ask it straight from Feishu / Telegram / WeCom on your phone — it works on your computer and sends the result back into the chat.
Prereqs: this Mac has Claude installed & logged in, and won't sleep (Settings can keep it awake).
guide.telegram_steps:
1. In Telegram, find @BotFather, send /newbot, follow the prompts, get a token.
2. Open telegram/.env, put the token in TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.
3. Send any message to your new bot.
4. Go to Channels → Who can use it, tap Add on yourself under "Wants to join".
5. Done. DM it, or @ it in a group.
guide.feishu_steps:
1. Open the open.feishu.cn dev console, create a custom internal app.
2. Add Bot capability.
3. In Permissions, enable im:message and related message permissions.
4. In Event Subscription, choose "long connection" delivery and add the receive-message event.
5. Get App ID / App Secret, put them in feishu-claude/.env.
6. Publish, add the bot to a group.
7. @ the bot in the group once, then tap Add under Who can use it.
guide.wecom_steps:
1. In the WeCom admin console, create a smart bot, get its ID / Secret.
2. Put them in wecom/.env.
3. @ the bot in a group once, then tap Add under Who can use it.
Note: WeCom is for coworkers/customers — it can't chat personal WeChat friends.
claude.not_logged_in: Claude installed but not logged in / no usable plan
